analyzed_vuln.description: AllocEmptyTransform explicitly accepts the special case where both raster formats are 0 (lines 913-916), leaves p->FromInput and p->ToOutput NULL, but still installs CachedXFORM/another normal transform worker and returns a non-NULL transform. A subsequent cmsDoTransform reaches CachedXFORM, which unconditionally calls p->FromInput at line 535, causing the observed indirect call to address 0. The vulnerable construction path should reject an immediately unusable zero-format transform or otherwise ensure it cannot execute until valid formatters are installed.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The harness takes the first two attacker-controlled 32-bit words as srcFormat and dstFormat. Both must be zero, as in this PoV. The following 512 bytes must form an ICC profile that cmsOpenProfileFromMem accepts and from which lcms can build a transform pipeline to the generated sRGB destination; the supplied profile contains a malformed/unusual but accepted GRAY/Lab profile with an A2B0 mft2 LUT. cmsCreateTransform then returns a transform despite both formatters being NULL. Calling cmsDoTransform for at least one pixel dispatches CachedXFORM, which calls the NULL FromInput formatter and jumps to the zero page.

args: In lcms/src/cmsxform.c, why does AllocEmptyTransform permit both InputFormat and OutputFormat to be zero, and are there legitimate internal callers that rely on constructing a transform with both formats zero and later installing formatters? What is the safest root-cause fix consistent with API behavior?

The reported crash occurs when cmsCreateTransform is called with attacker-controlled srcFormat=0 and dstFormat=0. AllocEmptyTransform accepts the pair due to a special conditional around lines 913-916, leaves p->FromInput and p->ToOutput NULL, installs CachedXFORM or another ordinary worker, and cmsDoTransform then calls the NULL FromInput callback. I have not yet modified code. I need to determine whether rejecting the all-zero pair could break any legitimate internal path, or whether a special no-op worker/formatter setup is intended by this special case.
